cq_normalized: What are all the available distinct powers and the set of characters associated with each power?
sparql_query:
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX ns1: <http://dbkwik.webdatacommons.org/marvel.wikia.com/property/>
PREFIX ns2: <http://dbkwik.webdatacommons.org/ontology/>
PREFIX ns3: <http://dbkwik.webdatacommons.org/marvel.wikia.com/property/%3>
PREFIX ns7: <http://dbkwik.webdatacommons.org/marvel.wikia.com/property/alternate232%60>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?power ?powerLabel (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?charLabel; separator=", ") AS ?characters)
WHERE {
  {
    # Characters typed with a power-related class (e.g., Superhuman Agility, Superhuman Durability, Healing Factor)
    ?char a ?power .
    ?power rdfs:label ?powerLabel .
    FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?power), "/class/"))
    FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?powerLabel)), "superhuman") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?powerLabel)), "healing"))
  }
  UNION
  {
    # Characters categorized under power categories (e.g., Electrokinesis, Flight)
    ?char dcterms:subject ?power .
    ?power rdfs:label ?powerLabel .
    FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?power), "/resource/Category:"))
  }
  ?char rdfs:label ?charLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?power ?powerLabel
ORDER BY LCASE(STR(?powerLabel))
qualitative_notes:
- Query is difficult to parse
- It doesn't fully make sense to type a character with a power
- Why is superhuman and healing in particular being filtered for?
- No entities are being typed with explicit types; URIs are just being checked to see if they contain specific strings
